question_text: Identify the sentence that avoids a dangling modifier.

options.text: Having completed the audit, the report was submitted to the Bureau of Internal Revenue.
Having completed the audit, the CPA submitted the report to the Bureau of Internal Revenue.
Walking into the office, the computer was left turned on overnight.
While reviewing the documents, a syntax error was discovered by the clerk.

hint_ladder.title: Hanapin ang -ing Phrase
hint_ladder.text: Alamin: ang '-ing' phrase sa simula ay may aksyon. Kailangan ng subject na gagawa nito.

hint_ladder.title: Comma Test: Sino ang Kasunod?
hint_ladder.text: Pagkatapos ng comma, hanapin ang noun. Dapat siya yung gumagawa ng aksyon sa simula.

hint_ladder.title: I-Test Bawat Option
hint_ladder.text: Option A: report? hindi nag-audit. C: computer? hindi naglalakad. D: error? hindi nagre-review. B lang: CPA ang nag-audit.

hint_ladder.title: Piliin ang Tama
hint_ladder.text: Ang tamang sagot: kung saan tugma ang subject sa aksyon. Gamitin ang trick: 'Sino gumawa?' S'ya dapat.

A.text: You might have chosen A because it sounds formal, but 'Having completed the audit' needs a person, not a report.

B.text: Correct. The CPA performs the action of completing the audit, so the modifier attaches logically.

C.text: You might have chosen C because you thought of the person walking, but the subject is 'the computer', which cannot walk.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you saw 'clerk', but the subject after comma is 'a syntax error', which cannot review.

next_time_rule: When you see an '-ing' phrase, ask 'Sino gumawa?' The noun after the comma must be the doer. If not, it's a dangling modifier.
blueprint_id: Dangling Modifiers — Aligning Introductory Participle with Logical Subject
deconstruct_text:
Sa isang LGU audit, iniisip natin: 'Having completed the audit, the report was submitted.' Pero parang mali, diba? Kasi ang report hindi naman nag-audit. Dapat tao. Ito ang dangling modifier – mapanlinlang pero kayang solusyunan.

Mental Trick: 'Ang gumagawa, siya ang bida after comma.' Parang sa pila ng jeep: kung sino ang nagbayad ng pamasahe, siya ang uupo sa tabi ng driver. Kung hindi tugma, dangle yan.

**Watch-Out Zone: dangling_modifier_error** in action. Report hindi nag-audit; tao dapat.

Sa options: A at C at D mali dahil report, computer, syntax error hindi sila gumagawa ng action sa simula. B lang ang tama: CPA ang nag-complete ng audit. Kaya tandaan: comma + subject na gumawa.
